CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.giao_hang AS
        SELECT
            id AS ma_giao_hang,
            ma_don_hang,
            shipper_id AS ma_shipper,
            status AS trang_thai_giao_hang,
            assigned_at AS thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen,
            picked_up_at AS thoi_gian_lay_hang,
            delivered_at AS thoi_gian_ket_thuc,
            estimated_time_minutes AS thoi_gian_du_kien_phut,
            delivery_fee AS phi_giao_hang,
            is_batched AS giao_ghep,
            "shipperId" AS ma_shipper_quan_he,
            ("shipperId" IS NOT NULL AND "shipperId" <> shipper_id) AS xung_dot_khoa_tai_xe
        FROM orders.shipper_delivery;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.danh_gia_chi_nhanh AS
        SELECT 
            dg.id,
            dg.ma_chi_nhanh,
            COALESCE(cn.ten_chi_nhanh, dg.ten_chi_nhanh, dg.ma_chi_nhanh) AS ten_chi_nhanh,
            dg.ma_nguoi_dung,
            dg.diem_tong_quan AS so_sao,
            dg.nhan_xet,
            dg.ma_don_hang,
            dg.ngay_tao,
            dg.trang_thai AS trang_thai_goc,
            CASE WHEN dg.trang_thai = 'APPROVED' THEN 'PUBLIC_VISIBLE' WHEN dg.trang_thai IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'NOT_PUBLIC' END AS hien_thi_cong_khai,
            'v1'::text AS phien_ban_anh_xa_hien_thi
        FROM orders.danh_gia_chi_nhanh dg
        LEFT JOIN identity.chi_nhanh cn ON dg.ma_chi_nhanh = cn.ma_chi_nhanh;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.vi_khach_hang AS
        SELECT id AS ma_vi, customer_id AS ma_nguoi_dung, balance AS so_du, updated_at AS ngay_cap_nhat FROM orders.customer_wallet;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.the_qua_tang AS
        SELECT id AS ma_the, value AS menh_gia, current_balance AS so_du_hien_tai, theme AS chu_de, status::text AS trang_thai, redeemed_at AS ngay_su_dung, created_at AS ngay_phat_hanh FROM orders.gift_cards;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.shipper_nop_cod AS
        SELECT id AS ma_phieu_nop, shipper_id AS ma_shipper, branch_code AS co_so_ma, amount AS so_tien, status AS trang_thai, confirmed_at AS ngay_xac_nhan, created_at AS ngay_tao FROM orders.shipper_cod_remit;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.vi_shipper AS

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.lich_shipper AS
        SELECT id AS ma_lich, shipper_id AS ma_shipper, work_date AS ngay_lam, shift_name AS ten_ca, status AS trang_thai, created_at AS ngay_tao FROM orders.shipper_schedule;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.ngoai_le_giao_hang AS
        SELECT id AS ma_ngoai_le, shipper_id AS ma_shipper, delivery_id AS ma_giao_hang, exception_type AS loai_ngoai_le, status AS trang_thai, created_at AS ngay_tao FROM orders.shipper_exception;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.hoi_thoai_cskh AS

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.tin_nhan_cskh AS

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.bai_viet AS

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.ho_so_nhuong_quyen AS

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.ca_kiosk AS

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.vi_chu_kiosk AS
        SELECT ma_giao_dich, ma_nguoi_dung, so_tien, loai_giao_dich, ngay_tao FROM identity.vi_giao_dich;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.khao_sat_tra_loi AS
        SELECT p.id AS ma_phan_hoi, p.ma_bieu_mau, p.co_so_ma, p.ngay_tao, a.ordinality AS thu_tu_cau, a.value->>'cau_hoi_id' AS ma_cau_hoi, a.value->>'cau_hoi_tieu_de' AS cau_hoi,
            jsonb_typeof(a.value->'cau_tra_loi') AS kieu_tra_loi,
            COALESCE(o.value #>> '{}', a.value->>'cau_tra_loi') AS gia_tri,
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.value->'cau_tra_loi') = 'number' THEN (a.value->>'cau_tra_loi')::numeric END AS gia_tri_so,
            (jsonb_typeof(a.value->'cau_tra_loi') = 'array') AS chon_nhieu
        FROM orders.khao_sat_phan_hoi p
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.tra_loi) = 'array' THEN p.tra_loi ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY a(value, ordinality)
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.value->'cau_tra_loi') = 'array' THEN a.value->'cau_tra_loi' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) o(value) ON true;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW silver.thuong_loyalty_don AS
